title: Venue & Vendor Field Notebook — EdgeCon 2025 Booth Ops
content:
Quick reference for on‑site vendor ops, receipts, and expense capture. Use this as the single living doc for the booth lead and floater staff.

EVENT CONTEXT
- Event: EdgeCon 2025 (expo hall B)
- Booth: B-14 (island, two sides open)
- Dates on site: 2025-11-10 (arrive for setup) through 2025-11-13 (tear down complete midnight)
- Primary lead: Samira Khan (me) — carry corporate card + backup petty cash envelope

GOALS
- Keep vendor payments under control, avoid personal card reimbursements where possible
- Capture clean receipts (digital photo + upload within 24h)
- Maintain a single gl/code mapping for finance to speed reimbursement

PAYMENT RULES (TL;DR)
- Use Redwood corporate card for vendor invoices > $50 when vendor accepts card.
- For small one-off local purchases (parking, tips, last-minute cab), use petty cash (max $200 total) and collect receipts.
- No staff should use personal AmEx unless explicitly pre-approved by finance (link EVT-412).

RECEIPT CAPTURE WORKFLOW
1) Take high‑res photo immediately on phone (framing + include vendor name and total).
2) Upload to expense thread in slack (#edgecon-expenses) with label: [RECEIPT] VendorName YYYY-MM-DD $AMOUNT.
3) Fill quick form snapshot: vendor, amount, GL code, team, card used, reason. Record flights/meal per‑diem separately.
4) Paper receipts stored in envelope in shipping crate until scanned at end of day 2.

REIMBURSEMENT CODING (finance friendly)
- Meals (team): GL 6401 — use when meals are shared for team of 3+
- Meals (individual/incidentals): GL 6430
- Local vendor services (setup/rigging): GL 7210
- Shipping & courier: GL 7420
- Parking & tolls: GL 7510
Note: add "edgecon-2025" tag in expense memo to allow report filtering.

VENDOR CONTACTS (phone + notes)
1) Harbor Rigging Co. — Miguel Soto — +1 512-555-0196 — onsite by 06:30 11/10. Confirm bolt kit and extra gaff tape. Invoicing: net 14. Email: miguel@harborrig.com
2) QuickPrints Expo — Priya Shah — +1 512-555-0233 — banner oversize print pickup 11/09 (pickup code 8341). Accepts corporate card.
3) Local Catering (GreenFork) — Tomas Alvarez — +1 512-555-0477 — lunch boxed for staff (dietary: 3 vegan, 1 halal). Prepay invoice (card).
4) Onsite AV — TetraAV — +1 512-555-0604 — mic + A/V tech 11/10–11/12 (set on arrival). Put contact on fallback in case stream drops.
5) Courier (next-day crate return) — ExpressShip TX — +1 512-555-0110 — label: REDWOOD/EdgeCon B14. Account on file (acct #RWD-EX-22).

VENDOR NOTES / CONTRACT ITEMS
- Harbor Rigging: confirm that rigging team will secure heavy monitor mount to booth frame; request certificate of insurance copy before arrival (send to events-ops@redwood.ai).
- QuickPrints: hold final proofs until 11/05; avoid last-minute font swaps.
- Catering: tip included? Confirm on invoice or we add gratuity to petty cash.

ON-SITE TIMELINE (short)
- 11/09 evening: crates arrive to loading dock (logistics team to confirm).
- 11/10 06:00: Lead onsite, meet dock manager. 06:30 rigging begins. 08:00 booth structure up. 09:00 AV install. 11:30 first package drop. 13:00 staff lunch (test badge scan flow).
- 11/11–11/12: Show open 09:00–18:00. Rotate staff every 3.5 hours. Take 15m check-ins after each shift.
- 11/13 18:00: Begin teardown. 22:00 courier pickup window. Midnight: finish.

CARDS, ACCESS, & LOGISTICS
- Corporate card is in Samira’s wallet (last four: 3248) — primary for vendor invoices.
- Backup card (Elena) in travel pouch with copy of event insurance.
- Petty cash: $150 cash envelope. Signed out in the morning by Samira; track disbursements in petty-cash-sheet link (slack pinned).
- Dock credentials: pickup at exhibitor check-in counter — bring company badge + proof of identity.

EXPENSE EXAMPLES (cheat sheet for staff)
- Shipping crate to venue: charge to GL 7420 — use corporate card on pickup if required.
- Extra gaff tape roll: petty cash (small hardware store).
- Taxis for late-night vendor: petty cash or card if corporate approval by lead.

QUICK MESSAGES TO STAFF (copy into morning brief)
- "If you pay with cash, photo + slack upload immediately. No personal cards unless approved. If in doubt, call Samira."

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODOs
- Confirm Harbor Rigging insurance copy by 11/03 — Elaine to follow up. (assigned in EVT-412)
- Does QuickPrints require signed EULA for banner art? — Jenn checking.
- Confirm on-site power amps available (AV list says 2x20A circuits) — SRE to confirm by 11/04.

NOTES TO SELF (short)
- Bring small Swiss army, extra sharpies, label maker, velcro, backup ethernet.
- Download offline PDF of attendee list for rapid lead matching.
- Prep a small "vendor kit" (cash, printed receipts pad, sticky envelopes) and tuck in crate 1.

POST-EVENT (wrap checklist)
- Collect all receipts into envelope, scan and upload to finance folder by 11/15.
- Annotate any vendor disputes and open a ticket in EVT-412 if payment differences > $50.
- Quick retro: 11/18 10:00am — collect staff feedback (what worked, what broke).

Random shorthand / scribbles:
- be firm w/ AV: if stream drops, swap to fallback laptop and continue demos.
- final banner proof: "EdgeCon" not "EdgeCon 2024" (legacy art).

End of notes.
